Cell Counter counts cells in microscope photos and estimates live vs dead cells, on your own computer. Photos are never uploaded.

## Download

| Your computer | File |
| --- | --- |
| Mac (Apple or Intel chip, macOS 13 or newer) | `Cell-Counter-mac.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or 11 | `Cell-Counter-windows-setup.exe` |
| Linux (64-bit) | `Cell-Counter-linux.AppImage` |

## Opening it for the first time

The app is free and is not signed with a paid Apple or Microsoft certificate, so your computer shows a warning the first time.

- **Mac:** open the `.dmg` and drag Cell Counter to Applications. Open it once (macOS refuses), then go to **System Settings → Privacy & Security**, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** run the installer. If "Windows protected your PC" appears, click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.
- **Linux:** make the file executable (`chmod +x Cell-Counter-linux.AppImage`) and run it.

Prefer no download? Open the [web app](https://cell-counter.netlify.app) and install it from the browser.

Free research tool, not for diagnosis. Credits and licences are in the app's Guide and in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
